column1: # The material review's decisions (RT-MASTER-PLAN 14.2 change 8, 14.4), applied last by the cooker
# (hit_record::finish). A row a material: the model's file stem, the material's name (a trailing * matches names that
# begin so), then any of: class (dielectric gloss metal glass ramp emissive painted translucent water), roughness,
# metal, ior, thickness (units), tint keep, body, shine (0 to 16), emission (r g b), traced (hidden: a stand-in the
# tracer replaces, neither drawn nor met by a ray while tracing reflections; FB b85), a metal's kind (gold silver
# copper iron chrome brass platinum, or art: its own colour; c88), and through (0 to 1: the share of the sun its far
# side takes, its sun ray passing its own clump; leaves 0.6 and clouds 0.5 by name; c90). Empty fields keep the
# cooker's numbers; a note says what the picture showed. A mod's pack may carry a file of the same form.
